LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ArguedOnce: The entry was argued once already, and written twice for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Settled: The wrong is put right with {0}: the league carries the silver to them, and the deed against the colony is settled.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_TermsBack: Every league trades with the colony at its usual terms again.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Struck: {0} argues the entry, and if {0} wins it is struck out of the Waystone Book.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Twice: Written twice: the colony owes {0} silver, and every league trades with it at worse terms until it pays.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Worse: Every league trades with the colony {0}% worse until it pays, and the factor comes back to ask.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RoadDay: The road gang knocked off for the day, the road about {COUNT}% of the way across the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RoadDone: The road gang has laid the road the whole way across the colony's land, edge to edge.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RoadStays: {FACTION}'s road gang has gone on up the line, and their road of {FLOOR} stays where they laid it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RoadElsewhere: {FACTION}'s waymaster has found no way for the road round the colony's land, and the gang will lay it further off.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_HandPaid: {A_nameDef} has done a day on the road with the gang, and {X_nameDef} has paid {A_objective} {COUNT} silver for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SpurSilverLabel: the silver for the spur to {NAME}
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SpurStoneLabel: the stone for the spur to {NAME}
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_GangMealsPaid: The road gang paid {COUNT} silver for the colony's meals, left at the edge of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoBuilder: Nobody of the colony can do building work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Road: The road gang camps at the map's edge for some days and lays a road of {0} across the colony's land, a stretch a day.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_RoadRound: The road gang camps at the map's edge and lays its road of {0} round the colony's land, well clear of it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_RoadFields: The road runs over the colony's fields: {0} cells of them are dug up for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_RoadCamp: They offer a spur to the gate for silver or stone, may hire the colony's builder by the day, and buy food; a robber band may come against their camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Spur: The gang lays a spur from the colony's gate to the road, {0} cells, once the day's stretch is down.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Hand: {0} works the rest of the day on the road beside the gang, paid at its end.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_LittersDone: {FACTION}'s hospitallers have carried {COUNT} of the fallen raiders off to their sickhouse. {PEOPLES} will hear who let them go.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoneLying: Nobody of the raiders lies downed on the colony's land now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Litters: The hospitallers carry {0} downed raiders off the map to their sickhouse.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_LittersKeep: The colony keeps the other {0}, lying where they fell, to take or leave.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Kept: The colony keeps all {0} of them; the order says nothing, but writes it down.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoSickRoom: The colony has no room with two medical beds or more to give the sister.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoDoctor: The colony's doctor isn't up and well to help.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SickRound: {SISTER_nameDef} has been round the sick room's beds with the order's care: {COUNT} of the sick seen to.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SisterCaught: {SISTER_nameDef} has caught {ILLNESS} on {SISTER_possessive} rounds, and the colony is nursing {SISTER_objective} in one of its beds.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SickRoomOver: {SISTER_nameDef} of {FACTION} has given up the sick room and gone home: the sickness had a harder road through the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_SickRoom: The sick are carried to {0} ({1} now), and for {2} days a sister of the order doses them on rounds while the well stay out.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Spread: While it stands, the sickness passes from bed to bed at a third of its rate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_SisterRisk: {0} may catch it on the rounds (about {1}% in all, through the harm budget), and then the colony nurses {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_WardDone: {A_nameDef} has worked a day in the order's ward, and comes home knowing a great deal more of the sickbed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_WardEmpty: Nobody lies in the ward yet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BellComes: A sexton of the Quiet Bell has come for {THING}, who died in the order's ward.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SisterCarriesHome: {X_nameDef} is carrying {THING}, who died in the ward, home to {THING}'s people.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BodyHome: {BEARER_nameDef} has carried {DEAD} off the map toward home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_PatientWell: {THING} is well again, and has thanked the sisters and set off home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_PatientCarried: One of {THING} has carried a wounded friend in to the order's ward.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_PatientWalks: A stranger of {THING} has walked in to the order's ward, sick or hurt, and been put to bed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_IllnessCrossed: {THING} has crossed from the order's ward to the colony: {A_nameDef} has it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SickFed: their sick fed at the order's sickhouse
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_SparedNews: {FACTION}'s sisters have struck their field sickhouse and gone, the hut left standing; {COUNT} of the region's sick and wounded lay in it, and the colony's name is in the Book of the Spared.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Sickhouse: {0}'s sisters pitch a long hut of beds by the colony, and over the days {1} to {2} of the region's sick and wounded come to it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_SickhouseRisk: A sickness may cross from the ward to the colony (through the harm and illness budgets), a patient may die there, and a band may come for the medicine.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Ward: {0} works a day in the order's ward, on rounds beside the sisters.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_WardRisk: {0} may bring the sickness home (about {1}%, through the harm and illness budgets).
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Ours: The colony's own sick go to the ward's beds and are dosed with the rest.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Cross: With the colony's people in and out of the ward, a sickness there may cross to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Fed: Each people whose sick the colony feeds thinks better of it when the sisters go (+{0}).
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveIn: {FACTION}'s drove has come onto the colony's land at its edge: {COUNT} head of {KIND}, and the drovers with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveGrazed: {FACTION}'s drove has grazed the colony's open fields as it went: {COUNT} plants cropped to the ground.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveKick: {PAWN_nameDef} came too close to {ANIMAL_definite} of the drove, and it kicked: {PAWN_possessive} {PART} is hurt.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RideDone: {PAWN_nameDef} has ridden a day with {FACTION}'s drove, and comes in knowing more of beasts than in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveYoung: {FACTION}'s drovers have left {YOUNG_indefinite} of the drove at their fire for the colony, for the grass.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveHides: {FACTION}'s drovers have left {HIDES} {LEATHER} and {MILK} milk at their fire for the colony, for the grass.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DroveGone: {FACTION}'s drove has gone off the colony's land at the far edge.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoWayAcross: The drove has no way across the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Drove: {0} head of {1} cross the colony's land over two or three days, grazing as they go, their drovers' fire at the far edge.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Crops: Unfenced fields by its way lose crops: about {0} of the {1} plants within its reach.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_NoCrops: No unfenced field lies in its way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Kick: Rarely, a spooked beast kicks one of the colony who comes too close (through the harm budget).
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_DroveThanks: As they go, they leave a young beast of the drove, or hides and milk, at their fire.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Ride: {0} rides a day with the drove.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_DrivenOff: Raiders of {FACTION} are driving off {BEASTS} of the colony's as they go.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_LeftBehind: Its drovers fell or ran, and {ANIMAL_nameDef} is the colony's again where it stands.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CampFound: {HERDERS}'s riders followed the trail to {FACTION}'s camp, a tile or two off, where {BEASTS} of the colony's are tethered. They have gone ahead to wait for {PAWN_nameDef}, who is setting out to it as a caravan of one; when the caravan comes, they go in together.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RodeOut: {PAWN_nameDef} has set out from the map's edge for {PLACE}, a caravan of one on the thieves' trail.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_RiderStayed: {PAWN_nameDef} didn't ride out after all, and the herders went on without {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailCold: The thieves' camp has gone from where {FACTION}'s riders found it, and the trail is cold.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailWon: The thieves' camp is taken. {BEASTS} of the colony's are free to go home with its caravan, and {FACTION}'s riders ride home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailWonNone: The thieves' camp is taken, though none of the colony's beasts lived through it, and {FACTION}'s riders ride home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailBack: {FACTION}'s riders are back from the thieves' trail, leading {BEASTS} of the colony's home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailDue: They kept {DUE} as their due for the trail.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailNone: {FACTION}'s riders are back from the thieves' trail with nothing: the colony's beasts are gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TrailOnlyDue: {FACTION}'s riders are back from the thieves' trail: they found only {DUE}, and kept it as their due.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoRider: Nobody of the colony can be spared for the trail now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Trail: {0} rides with them to {1}'s camp a tile or two off, a caravan of one, and the herders' riders go in beside {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_TrailFight: The fight at the camp is the game's own, as any fight at a camp is; {0} may come home hurt, or not at all.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_TrailBeasts: Won, {0} come home with the colony's caravan.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Alone: The herders go alone: each beast comes back at about {0}%, and they keep one of those they bring as their due.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CountAloud: {COUNT} head, and every one of them here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CalfBorn: A calf has been born at the herders' camp: a young {THING}, on its feet already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_HardStarts: One of the herders' {THING} is calving, and it is going hard.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BirthOurs: {A_nameDef} brought the {THING}'s calf: both live, and the herders say the calf is the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BirthLive: The herders brought the {THING}'s calf themselves, and both live.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BirthLostOurs: {A_nameDef} brought the {THING}'s calf, but the mother was lost to it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_BirthLost: The herders brought the {THING}'s calf themselves, but the mother was lost to it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Afterbirth: The afterbirth at the herders' camp has drawn a predator in from the edge in the night: {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CalfMissing: A young {THING} of the herders' has wandered off, and they'll go looking for it with lanterns tonight.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CalfFound: {X_nameDef} found the missing {THING} by lantern light, and is walking it back to the herd.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CalfBack: The missing {THING} found its own way back to the herders' camp at first light.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_CalvingRegion: {FACTION}'s herders have gone home from the colony's ground with {COUNT} calves born there, and the drove roads hear of it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoHand: The colony's best hand at beasts isn't here to go.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoSecondHand: There's nobody else with beasts to go with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Calving: {0}'s herders bring {1} beasts in calf to the colony's sheltered ground for some days, the calves born at their camp; they ask for hay and offer milk.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_CalvingRisk: The afterbirth may draw a predator in at night (through the harm budget), and a calf may go missing.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_CalvingThanks: After a good stay their people remember it ({0} +{1}).
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Birth: {0} goes to the herders' camp and works the {1}'s hard birth, an hour and a half at it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Calf: If both live, the calf is the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Herders: The herders see the birth through with their own hands.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineBlessed_ancient: {FACTION}'s pilgrims have set the last stone and lit the lamp beside the {HOLY}, and blessed it: the old shrine is the colony's now, and pilgrims will stop there in spring and summer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineBlessed_grave: {FACTION}'s pilgrims have set the last stone and lit the lamp by the {HOLY} older than the colony, and blessed it: the old shrine is the colony's now, and pilgrims will stop there in spring and summer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineBlessed_tree: {FACTION}'s pilgrims have set the last stone and lit the lamp under the great old {HOLY}, and blessed it: the old shrine is the colony's now, and pilgrims will stop there in spring and summer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineBlessed_landmark: {FACTION}'s pilgrims have set the last stone and lit the lamp for {HOLY}, and blessed it: the old shrine is the colony's now, and pilgrims will stop there in spring and summer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineBlocked: {FACTION}'s pilgrims came to set the last stone and found the spot taken, and went on their way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineMourned: The old shrine by the {HOLY} has fallen to ruin, and {FACTION}'s pilgrims mourn it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineKept: The old shrine stands mended again, and {FACTION}'s pilgrims say so on the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_ShrineStop: {PILGRIM_nameDef} of {FACTION} stopped at the old shrine on the road, prayed a while and left {COUNT} {WHAT} at its foot.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoHelper: Nobody else of the colony can work beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Shrine: Two pilgrims set stones and a lamp by the {0} for {1} days, then bless it, and it becomes a building of the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_ShrineStops: From then on pilgrims stop there in spring and summer and leave a little silver or herbs, and the colony's faithful feel it when they pray there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_ShrineRuin: Left out in the weather it wears, and let fall to ruin, {0} mourn it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TableSettled: The palmer's blessing at one table held: {FAITHS} rest easier for a season, {COUNT} of their believers the steadier for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TableSplit: The table did not hold: those who waver in {FAITH} are further from it than before, and the split is coming.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_TableSplitClash: The table did not hold: {FAITHS} are no nearer for the evening, and both sides went to bed less sure than they came.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_NoGathering: The colony's answers don't play out on the map now, so there can be no evening.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Settle: Settled, the faiths' quarrel rests for {0} days, and both sides' believers who came are {1}% surer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Split: The split comes anyway: {0}'s wavering are shaken further, and it is said plainly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_Apart: {0} walks about the colony blessing each believer of the two sides in turn, no evening and no speeches.
LanguageData.CC_PEv3_Impact_ApartSteady: Each blessed is {0}% surer, and the quarrel is left as it is.
